narrative: On the board. The unsent letter of Sunday, still on the desk. Three new lines at the foot, in the same hand, not struck. The date above is still the 9th. On the board. The space under those lines is blank. No second number. The pen is set down beside the leaf, not on it. On the board. The leaf is not folded for a carrier. Sunday's barges and the long account of the comedy are still above the new lines. Nothing is wrapped.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the three lines and left the letter where it was.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Is still the person the leaf addresses, and is not in the room.

entities.name: draft
entities.context: Shown on draft in Forty sail, under Sunday's date
